headlines.title: NASA Announces MAX POWER: America’s Newest Aerospace Expo, Airshow
headlines.summary: In honor of America’s historic 250th anniversary, NASA announced on Friday MAX POWER, a public exposition of American air and space innovation, Nov. 7 and Nov. 8, on and near the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
